plan.title: Add surrogate bid to eRFX RFQ

steps.note: Open the existing RFQ project's Participants tab, as required for a prepared-state case.
Enable eRFX project features required by the case.
Enable surrogate bidding for the prepared event.
Enter and submit a buyer-created bid for Vendor A.
Assert that the surrogate bid was accepted.
Verify the buyer's Responses view shows the newly added bid marked as a surrogate bid.
Open the comparison grid to verify the bid is included for ranking.
Assert that both the existing bidder and Vendor A have real vendor columns in Master QCS.
Verify the surrogate bid participates in Master QCS ranking by RFQ amount.
